BL-0.1.4-003-S1.title: Lock TTL Schema and Ownership Contract
BL-0.1.4-003-S1.description: Define the lock data model including TTL, owner identity, acquisition timestamp, renewal rules, and uniqueness constraints to guarantee deterministic expiration and enforce single-owner control.

BL-0.1.4-003-S2.title: TTL Enforcement and Expiration Handling Logic
BL-0.1.4-003-S2.description: Implement TTL evaluation during lock read/write operations, ensuring expired locks are invalidated, safely cleaned up, and never reused across Brain execution cycles.

BL-0.1.4-003-S3.title: Recovery Orchestration and Forced Lock Reacquisition
BL-0.1.4-003-S3.description: Implement controlled recovery flow that safely overrides expired or orphaned locks, including retry guards, ownership validation, and integration with assignment execution to resume processing without duplication.

BL-0.1.4-003-S4.title: Internal Lock Management API
BL-0.1.4-003-S4.description: Provide internal methods for acquire, renew, release, and force-release operations and integrate them into brain_runner execution flow to enforce lock lifecycle consistently during assignment processing.

BL-0.1.4-003-S5.title: Concurrency Stress and Chaos Testing for Locking
BL-0.1.4-003-S5.description: Design tests simulating concurrent lock contention, forced expirations, and crash-recovery scenarios to validate TTL enforcement, recovery correctness, and absence of duplicate execution under stress.
